'''September 2000 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC on 2 September 2000. [[Adam Weinstein]] won it. It is known from Mike Merletto's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1204">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-raleigh-nc-9-2-00d1204/ raleigh-nc-9-2-00], DeckTech (Mike "OQrygg" Merletto, 5 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-raleigh-nc-9-2-00d1204/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 22
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Weinstein]]
